Test Steps: Navigate to My Invoices -> Open generated invoice

Test Steps: Search for an unavailable product

Test Steps: Open Cart -> Click Remove from Cart
Expected Result: Selected product is removed from the cart

Expected Result: Validation messages are displayed and the order cannot be placed

Test Steps: Open generated invoice -> Verify invoice number -> Verify customer details -> Verify product name -> Verify quantity -> Verify unit price -> Verify total

Test Steps: Click Logout
Expected Result: User is logged out and authenticated-only functionality is no longer accessible

Test Steps: Open invoice -> Verify product -> Verify quantity -> Verify unit price -> Verify line total -> Verify order total
